assumptions: The calculation is exactly at lambda=0 and only on the five full upstream kappa brackets; it is neither a point sample nor a cover of all kappa in [0,8].
The exact Green identity is used directly. The earlier Liouville-Green error inequality is not differentiated and supplies no h error term here.
For real kappa and positive x, K_(i*kappa)(x) is real by conjugation and K order symmetry. The finite quadrature still retains the full complex ball and requires its imaginary part to contain zero.
The DLMF 10.32.9 representation and cosh(t)>=1+t^2/2 give |K_(i*kappa)(x)|<=K_0(x)<=exp(-x)*sqrt(pi/(2x)); this bounds only the manually separated improper tail.
Every denominator is evaluated on an entire exact-rational kappa bracket and must have a strictly positive real lower bound. A bracket for which zero is not excluded fails closed.
Both precision tiers use the same locked python-flint/FLINT-Arb backend. Their overlap and refinement are consistency checks, not independent validation.
A numerical amplitude F_lambda remains normalization-dependent away from an endpoint root. This calculation emits only the normalization-invariant h(4) datum and no endpoint transport.

certified_calculation.correct_plus_end_condition: u^2*h tends to zero; h itself is not set to zero
certified_calculation.next_mathematical_gap: transport h from Qplus=4 to Q0=-4 through an unwrapped node-safe Pruefer/projective atlas; an amplitude F_lambda additionally needs an explicit amplitude convention away from roots

declared_conventions.correct_plus_end_condition: u(Q)^2*h(Q) tends to zero; h itself grows asymptotically and is not set to zero
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint/Arb Bessel balls and rigorous acb.integral on a finite positive-real segment; no ODE solve, root solve, finite difference or unbounded numerical quadrature
declared_conventions.improper_tail_majorant: J_tail<=pi*exp(-2Y)/(4*sqrt(x_plus+Y)); divide by sqrt(C)*S_kappa(x_plus)^2 for the h-tail
declared_conventions.kappa_source: the five full 120-digit sign-change brackets certified by the pinned upstream result

exact_checks.statement: Under u_lambda -> c(lambda)u_lambda, h is invariant and the c'(0) term cancels exactly.
S=exp(x)K removes the common superexponential scale without changing the h integrand.
The leading recessive sensitivity scale grows as exp(Q/2)/2, so h(infinity)=0 is not the boundary condition.
The exponential part of the manual improper-tail majorant integrates exactly to exp(-2Y)/2.

primary_sources.not_used_for: the emitted ball quadrature, nonzero-lambda transport, endpoint F_lambda, spectral data or RAQ
primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel order symmetry and integral representation, sections 10.27 and 10.32, especially 10.32.9
primary_sources.used_for: K_(i*kappa) reality together with order symmetry, and K_(i*kappa)(x)=integral exp(-x cosh t) cos(kappa t)dt for the uniform improper-tail majorant

primary_sources.not_used_for: the Green identity, improper-tail theorem or a raw-C operator conclusion
primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic

primary_sources.not_used_for: improper integration without a manual tail bound, or treating same-backend precision repeats as independent validation
primary_sources.source: python-flint acb complex-ball integration and special-function interface
primary_sources.used_for: locked access to rigorous finite acb.integral enclosures and scaled complex-order Bessel K balls, with the analytic flag forwarded to square root

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: h(Q)=u(Q)^(-2) integral_Q^infinity A_lambda u^2 is positive and invariant under u_lambda -> c(lambda)u_lambda. This guard fixes the correct plus-end condition; it does not provide node transport or an amplitude F_lambda.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: u is the lambda-zero recessive K direction, v=partial_lambda u after any differentiable amplitude convention, (u^2 h)'=-A_lambda u^2, and u^2 h tends to zero although h itself grows
theorem_guards.theorem: variation-of-parameters / Lagrange identity for a parameter-differentiated second-order scalar equation

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The true real function satisfies |K_(i*kappa)(x)|<=exp(-x)sqrt(pi/(2x)), uniformly on each real kappa band. This supplies only the explicit improper-tail upper bound after the finite rigorous quadrature.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: x>0 and kappa is real; K_(-nu)=K_nu and conjugation make K_(i*kappa)(x) real, while K_(i*kappa)(x)=integral exp(-x cosh t)cos(kappa t)dt and cosh t>=1+t^2/2

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: Each finite-segment output is a rigorous complex ball enclosure. Improper integration is not delegated to acb.integral and is handled by the separate DLMF majorant.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: the integration endpoints are finite; every callback is capped; the path has Re(x)>0; sqrt receives the analytic flag; complex-order Bessel balls, tolerances and all work limits are retained
theorem_guards.theorem: python-flint 0.9.0 acb.integral backed by FLINT/Arb acb_calc_integrate

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The emitted finite integral ball encloses the union of the true integrals over the entire declared kappa bracket. This is not a point sample and does not extend coverage beyond the five brackets.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: every precision tier proves that its kappa ball contains the exact real bracket endpoints; each fixed real kappa in that interval selects an analytic positive-real-x integrand; all fixed parameters are evaluated through the same order ball
theorem_guards.theorem: inclusion isotonicity of Arb/acb ball evaluation with an analytic x integrand

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: Overlap and strict width refinement are retained as implementation consistency checks only. They are not labeled an independent backend verification.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: 80- and 120-decimal runs use the same locked python-flint/FLINT-Arb implementation with different requested tolerances

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: No node-safe Qplus-to-Q0 transport, numerical F_lambda amplitude, root velocity, nonreal m-function, spectral measure, rigging map, RAQ, physics, quantum-gravity or TOE conclusion follows.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: the calculation stops at Qplus=4 and emits h=partial_lambda[-u_Q/u], not a transported variational amplitude
